step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify nodes from visual elements on the whiteboard:
- KMS (AWS Service: KMS)
- EKS (AWS Service: EKS)
- Elasticsearch (AWS Service: OpenSearch)
- Aurora (AWS Service: Aurora)
- PrivateLink (AWS Service: PrivateLink)
- Transit Gateway (AWS Service: TransitGateway)
- EC2 (AWS Service: EC2)
- S3 (AWS Service: S3)
- User / Actor icons at the bottom representing external users/consumers accessing the platform.

2. Identify edges from visible drawn arrows:
- User -> EKS: Users connect to the control plane UI via EKS.
- EKS -> KMS: EKS integrates with KMS for encryption key management.
- EKS -> OpenSearch: EKS pushes data/analytics to Elasticsearch (OpenSearch).
- EKS -> Aurora: EKS stores metadata in Aurora.
- EKS -> PrivateLink: EKS routes inter-region data plane traffic through PrivateLink.
- EKS -> Transit Gateway: EKS routes cross-region traffic via Transit Gateway.
- PrivateLink -> EC2: PrivateLink connects control plane to EC2 in the data plane.
- Transit Gateway -> S3: Transit Gateway connects to S3 storage in the data plane.
